Name: Nyapu Style Daulton and Maple by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Daulton and Maple- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt[/center]
[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. 

I finished several mods this week, so I hope you all enjoy the drops. :D (I'll publish one each day this weekend- Fri, Sat, Sun)

I had to add Daulton and Maple. A handsome man and a cute bunny? What's there not to like about that? Anyways, Daulton wasn't too bad to retexture, but Maple was very hard to draw. (And to be honest, I still don't think I did Maple justice, but I tried my best). Anyways I hope you enjoy the retextures I created. 

[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35087]Daulton and Maple - A Custom NPC Mod[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[i][b]Extra:[/b]
For some reason, when I coded the CP for this mod, Maple's winter and summer portraits would not show up at first. So I had to force code them in, which means the Winter and Summer portraits will show up, but you won't be able to change Maple's winter and summer sprites. [/i]
[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120986538]bigsquishy0[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.

[b]
[/b][i][b]Shout out!:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57920436]PureJJoy[/url] Created their own Nyapu retextures. Check out their mod: [i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38691]Daulton and Maple - Nyapu's Style[/url][/i][/i][/i]
